project.description:
The Relation Grid's selection (RFC 0050 · Episode 2, map 5), and nothing else. A selection is an ORDERED LIST OF RANGES, each a rectangle of positions owning both its corners, the smallest 1x1, never merged and never reordered. The module manages that list and answers what is selected when something else is triggered; it never initiates anything.
A module of its own because the guarantee is worth making structural: this one imports NOTHING. Not the view maps, not the layout, not the cells, not the cursor — the two operations that need any of those take them as arguments (the cursor's position for the implicit 1x1, the extents for select-all). No DOM. Positions in, positions out, which is why its whole test suite runs on a bare JS context with no stub.
What is deliberately NOT here: the cursor, which is identity-first, tells its cell and paints, so it stays with the grid; clamping, which belongs to whoever knows the presented space; and the paint, which is the layout's. See map 5 laws 215-218.
